notes: This is rule 45's *And it was so, that when …* shape: the ASV writes the complementizer immediately after the frame, ahead of the temporal clause, so the frame keeps it and the apodosis waw is unrepresented.
`כַּאֲשֶׁר` fuses under rule 30 headed on the governing opening morpheme; aligning `כְּ` to *when* and marking `אֲשֶׁר` unrepresented was the alternative.
